coach_verdict: Focus on Priority 1 today: a strict Zone 2 Aerobic Base Run. After an 8-day layoff, jumping straight into high-intensity VO2max intervals poses unnecessary muscular shock. Establish aerobic stimulus today, rebuild your routine, and save the high-intensity 5-min cycling power efforts for when acute workload is stabilized.

priority_1.reason: Highest priority to safely kickstart your CTL ramp rate after an 8-day break while keeping injury risk low and laying down aerobic base.

priority_3.workout_details: Barbell Back Squats: 4x6 @ 80kg; Barbell Overhead Press: 3x8 @ 40kg; Sandbag Cleans: 3x6 @ 70kg; Dumbbell/Kettlebell Core & Upper Aesthetics (Bench/Biceps/Planks): 3x10-12.
